extension.summary: Richard Keymer's personal Kodi addon repository
Self-healing patch for Homelander season-pack episode resolution
extension.description: Repairs plugin.video.homelander so multi-file (season-pack) torrents resolve to the requested episode instead of whatever file the debrid resolver picks by default, and re-applies the resolveurl AllDebrid dn= filename match. Runs on Kodi startup, is idempotent, and self-heals after a Homelander or resolveurl update reverts the fix. No-ops if those add-ons are not installed. Cross-platform (Windows, Android, Linux).
